scenes.headline: IPL 12 TEAMS?
scenes.subtitle: BCCI Drops a Massive Update!
scenes.body_text: Are 12 teams really coming to the Indian Premier League?
scenes.voiceover_text: IPL lo 12 teams expect chesthunnara? BCCI ippude BIG SHOCK ichindi!
video_prompts: Golden T20 cricket championship trophy gleaming on a pedestal under dramatic stadium floodlights at night, fast cinematic zoom in, intense atmosphere, vertical 9:16

scenes.headline: BCCI SAYS NO!
scenes.subtitle: 10 Teams vs 12 Teams Expansion
scenes.body_text: Immediate expansion to 12 teams in 2028 is almost impossible.
scenes.voiceover_text: 2028 lo IPL expand avvadam almost impossible!

scenes.headline: ZERO DISCUSSIONS!
scenes.subtitle: BCCI Secretary Devajit Saikia
scenes.body_text: No formal or informal talks held — 12-team expansion rumours are pure speculation.
scenes.voiceover_text: BCCI Secretary Devajit Saikia clear ga chepparu. 12 teams gurinchi formal discussion ledu. Informal discussion kuda jaragaledu! Ante 12 teams news antha speculation maatrame!
video_prompts: Official cricket board press conference podium with broadcast microphones and flashing camera strobes in a sleek dark media briefing room, dramatic cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

scenes.headline: IPL 2027 = 20TH EDITION
scenes.subtitle: BCCI's Real Focus Is 2027
scenes.body_text: Full attention is on making the landmark 20th edition of IPL massive.
scenes.voiceover_text: Kaani ikkada interesting matter enti telusa? BCCI focus 2028 meeda kaadu. 2027 IPL meeda undi! Endukante 2027 IPL tournament ki 20th edition.
video_prompts: Slow cinematic orbit around a gleaming golden cricket trophy at center pitch inside a packed night stadium with roaring crowd lights and golden fireworks, vertical 9:16

scenes.headline: ₹125 CR → ₹150 CR?
scenes.subtitle: Auction Purse Rumours & Mega Auction
scenes.body_text: Rumours suggest a ₹150 Cr purse hike ahead of next year's mega auction, though unconfirmed by BCCI.
scenes.voiceover_text: Inko interesting update! IPL auction purse 125 crores nunchi 150 crores ki increase avuthundani rumours unnayi. Kaani BCCI official ga confirm cheyyaledu! Mega auction kuda next year schedule avuthundi.

scenes.headline: JANUARY IPL?
scenes.subtitle: March 2027 Remains the Target
scenes.body_text: Despite Juhi Chawla's January suggestion, BCCI is locked on a March 2027 window.
scenes.voiceover_text: Inka Juhi Chawla January lo IPL conduct cheyyalani suggest chesaru. Kaani BCCI response? March 2027 nunchi IPL start cheyyadame maa focus ani clear chesindi!

scenes.headline: 10 TEAMS vs 12 TEAMS?
scenes.subtitle: Drop Your Vote in the Comments!
scenes.body_text: Do you want 12 teams or a bigger 10-team IPL? Subscribe to T20CricTank for more updates!
scenes.voiceover_text: So, IPL fans... Meeru em korukuntunnaru? 12 teams expansion aa? Leda existing 10 teams tho bigger IPL aa? Mee opinion comments lo cheppandi. Ilaanti IPL updates kosam T20CricTank subscribe avvandi!
